nome_jp: 戦場のピアニスト VAN・ビート
testo:
Multi
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a King Command Dragon. Put that card into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
■ When this creature is destroyed, you may put a Dragon creature from your hand or mana zone into the battle zone.
